decision_rule: Primary proxies: intent_duplicate_rate, longitudinal_repetition, change_followup_rate, min_per_category, synthetic_rating_quality. 'Better'/'worse' = the 95% paired-bootstrap CI of (V2 − V1) excludes 0 in the favourable/unfavourable direction. 'V2 improves the measured question-selection proxies' if >=1 primary proxy is better and none is worse; 'V2 produces mixed results' if some are better and some worse; 'V2 does not outperform the baseline on the current evaluation' if none is better.
clinical_accuracy: NOT EVALUATED (no outcome labels; synthetic data only)
